messages.content: I think I need to cut back on how much I check my phone.
Honestly, that's a really common realization lately. What usually triggers the checking - boredom, anxiety, or more of a habit at this point?
Mostly boredom I think, like a reflex when there's a gap.
That's actually the easiest one to work with, honestly - reflexive boredom-checking responds well to just having something else physical nearby, like a book or even a fidget object.
I'll try that, feels almost too simple though.
Simple doesn't mean ineffective, honestly - a lot of habit changes are less about willpower and more about removing the reflex's easiest target.
